admin.intake.explainer.example_summary: Productive cough and a 38.5 °C fever for 4 days. Short of breath climbing stairs. Non-smoker. Takes enalapril.
admin.intake.explainer.gain_1: the reason, since when, the history and the medication are already written down.
admin.intake.explainer.gain_2: tick them or write your own, and add medication from a list. The proposal is not a medical order: you decide.
admin.intake.explainer.gain_2_strong: You see possible diagnoses and suggested tests:
admin.intake.explainer.gain_3_strong: The prescription and the order come out ready to print,
admin.intake.explainer.gain_4: in red, at the top of My patients, with an alert on the bell.
admin.intake.explainer.gain_4_strong: Cases with warning signs come first:
admin.intake.explainer.how_1: when booking, in the appointment emails and the day before. At the office door, through the QR on the poster.
admin.intake.explainer.how_1_strong: The patient gets «Tell the doctor how you feel»
admin.intake.explainer.how_2: typed or dictated, in their own language. At the door it is 4 or 5.
admin.intake.explainer.how_2_strong: They answer up to about 8 questions, one at a time,
admin.intake.explainer.how_3: If the patient asks for advice, it answers that the doctor will. If they describe an emergency, it stops and tells them to get care now.
admin.intake.explainer.how_3_strong: It does not diagnose or advise.
admin.intake.explainer.how_4: not just the AI: the AI can raise the priority, never lower it.
admin.intake.explainer.how_4_strong: Warning signs are flagged by a fixed check,
admin.intake.explainer.lead: You get it with the symptoms in order and a proposal ready to review.
admin.intake.explainer.lead_strong: Before the visit, the patient tells a chat what is wrong.
admin.intake.explainer.privacy: before the text goes to the AI, the name, ID number, phone and address are replaced with labels. A photo the patient attaches is sent as is.
